create_to_tokens: create tokenized input IDs from text using a HuggingFace tokenizer with configurable BOS and padding
create_to_str_tokens: create string tokens from text by decoding tokenizer output into human-readable token strings
test_find_exact_substrings_token_positio: test finding exact substring positions within batched token ID tensors using string matching
run_get_completion: run extraction of generated completion text from model outputs by decoding tokens after the prompt
summarize_requires_prepending_space: summarize whether a tokenizer requires a leading space before a target string for correct tokenization
